name: ThresholdLineChart
description: Line chart with optional horizontal threshold lines. Wraps `ChartContainer` and `LineChart`; pass `series` and optional `thresholds` via `data`

props.name: title
props.description: Chart title (unit appended when `unit` is set)

props.name: unit
props.description: Shown in title and axis/tooltip formatting

props.name: isTall
props.description: When true, uses a taller default height (360px)

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when data is missing or all zero

fields.name: series
fields.description: Data lines; points with a non-finite timestamp are dropped. All-zero values render the empty state

fields.name: thresholds
fields.description: Horizontal reference lines at a fixed `value`, spanning every timestamp in `series`
